description: This file defines a PHP class for handling CSV-based database connections within the ADODB database abstraction layer. It includes methods for connecting to CSV data sources, executing queries, and fetching results, encapsulated within the ADODB_csv class, along with a related recordset class.

classes.name: ADODB_csv
classes.description: A class representing a database connection to CSV data, supporting basic operations such as connect, execute, and retrieve metadata.

classes.name: ADODBRecordset_csv
classes.description: A class representing the result set of a CSV query, extending ADORecordset.

methods.name: ADODB_csv
methods.description: Constructor for ADODB_csv class, initializes the CSV database connection object.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Returns the last inserted ID from the CSV source, if applicable.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Stub method for returning metadata databases, returns false indicating unsupported.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Stub method for returning metadata columns for a given table, returns false indicating unsupported.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with limit and offset, returning a result set.

methods.name: _Execute
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement against the CSV data source.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from database operations.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number from database operations.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the connection, here implemented as a no-op returning true.
